facts.en: Completed a building-services fundamentals diploma at Fictional Oakduct College in 2022.
facts.zh: 2022 年在虚构橡风管学院完成建筑设备基础文凭课程。

facts.en: Paid stores assistant at Fictional Willowfitting Supplies from 2018-06 to 2022-07.
facts.zh: 2018-06 至 2022-07 在虚构柳配件用品公司任有薪物料助理。

facts.en: In that role, matched labelled ventilation fittings to approved pick lists and recorded stock discrepancies.
facts.zh: 在该职位将带标签通风配件与获批拣货单匹配，并记录库存差异。

facts.en: Paid commissioning support technician at Fictional Meadowduct Services from 2023-01 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-01 至 2026-08 在虚构草风管服务公司任有薪调试支持技术员。

facts.en: Records airflow readings at engineer-designated points using the approved site worksheet and assigned measuring instrument.
facts.zh: 使用获批现场工作表及分配的测量仪器，在工程师指定测点记录气流读数。

facts.en: Checks instrument ID, stated unit and room reference before entering readings into the commissioning record.
facts.zh: 将读数录入调试记录前，核对仪器编号、注明单位及房间编号。

facts.en: The commissioning engineer specifies adjustments and approves system performance; the candidate gathers and checks assigned readings.
facts.zh: 调试工程师指定调整并批准系统性能；候选人采集并核对分配的读数。

facts.en: Supported a 2025-06 office ventilation survey across 18 rooms.
facts.zh: 支持一项覆盖 18 个房间的 2025-06 办公室通风测查。

facts.en: The worksheet contains 54 readings because 3 designated points were measured in each room.
facts.zh: 该工作表包含 54 个读数，因为每个房间测量 3 个指定点。

facts.en: Personally collected readings in 10 rooms; another technician collected the remaining 8 rooms’ readings.
facts.zh: 个人在 10 个房间采集读数；另一名技术员采集其余 8 个房间的读数。

facts.en: The supplied worksheet does not include the engineer’s final system-performance approval.
facts.zh: 所供工作表不包含工程师对系统性能的最终批准。

facts.en: Uses labelled measurement worksheets, spreadsheet range checks and an instrument issue register.
facts.zh: 使用带标签测量工作表、电子表格范围检查及仪器领用登记册。

facts.en: Completed internal site-access and instrument-handling induction in 2023-01.
facts.zh: 2023-01 完成内部现场访问及仪器操作入职培训。

facts.en: Reports inaccessible measurement points and inconsistent references to the commissioning engineer.
facts.zh: 向调试工程师报告无法到达的测点及不一致编号。

facts.en: Volunteers with Fictional Breezepaper Makers Group, setting up tables for paper-model workshops.
facts.zh: 在虚构微风纸创客团体做志愿者，为纸模型工作坊布置桌子。

facts.en: Built a personal cardboard room model in 2024 to experiment with miniature furniture placement.
facts.zh: 2024 年制作个人纸板房间模型，以尝试微型家具摆放。

facts.en: Enjoys constructing paper mobiles and sketching imaginary building façades.
facts.zh: 爱好制作纸悬挂装饰及素描想象中的建筑立面。

facts.en: Prepares handovers listing incomplete measurements and records awaiting engineering review.
facts.zh: 准备交接，列明未完成测量及待工程审核记录。

facts.en: No independent electrical work, design approval or energy-savings verification is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录独立电气作业、设计审批或节能量核验工作。
